specification.objective: Correct four verified regressions in the shared task search while preserving existing Backlog behavior and accessible result reporting.

requirements.statement: A bare query token that is both a task-type synonym and a current-board column name remains literal text; explicit type: syntax continues to select a task type.
Backlog keeps its local title/card-number search available and intersects it with shared-query matches and existing manual filters.
For connector-only input whose parsed query is inactive, the accessible result count reflects the unfiltered cards rather than announcing zero matches.
When shared query text changes while Backlog is visible, pagination returns to its first page without clearing the local query or other Backlog state.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A parser test uses a current-board column named Bug and proves bare bug is literal text while explicit type:bug remains a type filter.
A Backlog widget test keeps the local search visible with shared matches and proves local and shared criteria intersect.
A page test enters only connector words, confirms the query remains inactive, and verifies the announced count equals all cards.
A Backlog widget test starts on page two, receives a changed shared query with multiple pages of matches, and verifies that pagination returns to page one.

invariants.statement: Search remains local and read-only; it does not mutate the board or send query/task data externally.
Manual Backlog filters and shared-query matching are conjunctive; neither silently disables the other.
The result count announced to assistive technology matches the result set implied by the parsed query.

forbidden_states.statement: A bare ambiguous type/status token silently filters tasks by type or status.
Shared search hides or bypasses Backlog's local title/card-number search.
An inactive parsed query announces zero results while the board remains unfiltered.
Changing shared query text leaves the user on a stale Backlog page or clears unrelated Backlog filters.

inputs.statement: The current PR #138 implementation at the locked baseline.
Verified review scenarios for Backlog filtering, parser ambiguity, accessible counts, and pagination.

outputs.statement: Minimal corrections in the shared search parser/page and Backlog view.
Focused regression tests and retained POLIS Red/validation evidence.

failure_semantics.statement: The Red probe fails on the locked baseline because the bare token bug is parsed as a task type even though Bug is also a current-board status; target tests pass after correction.
Compilation/setup errors are not accepted as behavioral Red evidence.
